info.title: Blygger Studio API
info.description: Private authoring and reading API. Protocol files remain a separate public interface.

scopes.owner:read: Read private drafts, reading material, media, and settings
scopes.owner:draft: Create and edit drafts, upload media, and use configured AI generation
scopes.owner:publish: Publish, withdraw, refresh, pin, and change public item responses or media
scopes.owner:manage: Change settings, subscriptions, signals, collections, and response moderation
scopes.reading:state: Mark reading entries read or unread

origin.description: Present for a remote source (0.4, §5.7); omitted for this blyg's own.

aiModelClassify.description: The change classifier's decision model (Clef, Jev); empty, the default, is off. Studio-private: a category reaches readers only as words in a changelog note the author confirms.

changeCategoryInNote.description: Lead the changelog note with the classifier's category, in the publish dialog where the author sees it. Matters only while aiModelClassify is set.

feedOrder.description: The public home page order: an id from feedOrders. pace-layered (the default) and reverse-chronological are core; extensions add orders named <extension>/<id>.

frontPage.description: A published thread's id shown at the mount root instead of the latest items; empty for the latest items. A front page later withdrawn or deleted falls back to the latest items.

postsPath.description: Where the latest items live: {mount}/{postsPath}/, served whether or not a front page is set. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; names the blyg already uses are refused.

linksPosition.description: Where the links section (main menu) sits on public pages: left (the default) or right is a sidebar on wide screens and a Menu button under the masthead on narrow ones; bottom puts it below the content at every width.

linksThreads.description: Published threads listed first in the links section, in order. A thread later withdrawn is left out.

linksExternal.description: The owner's own links in the links section.

linksCollections.description: List public collections in the links section.

linksOpml.description: Link the blogroll's OPML file in the links section, when the blogroll is not empty.

linksBlyggerOrg.description: Link blygger.org in the links section.

linksBlyggerCom.description: Link blygger.com, the directory of blygs, in the links section.

setup.description: The setup wizard: pending on a fresh install, notice on a node that published before it existed, done once finished or dismissed.

defaults.description: Read-only: what each setting reads as with nothing stored, for "reset to default". siteTitle's default is the title derived from the address; store "" to keep it derived.

feedOrders.description: Read-only: the home page orders this node can use now (core, plus enabled extensions').

extensions.description: Studio extensions enabled on this node (docs/extensions.md). Only names compiled into this build are accepted; every extension starts disabled.

keySecret.description: The Worker secret holding this provider's key. Absent for a Workers AI provider (it uses `binding`) and for a keyless OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

binding.description: Workers AI only: the Worker binding the provider calls (studio#8).

configured.description: The key secret is set, the binding is bound, or the provider needs neither.

kind.description: A decision model (Clef, Jev): offered only for the change classifier (aiModelClassify), never for text generation.

version.description: The version of the item held here. A readVersion below it means a newer version arrived after the owner read it.

readVersion.description: The highest version the owner has marked read; null when unread or cleared.

version.description: The version of the item held here. A readVersion below it means a newer version arrived after the owner read it.

readVersion.description: The highest version the owner has marked read; null when unread or cleared.

contentMd.description: The item's markdown as imported; empty for a withdrawn item and for feeds that carry none.

page.description: The origin's declared page, as the origin declared it; null when it declares none.

thumb.description: The owner's signal; null when none.

hoppers.description: Ids of the hoppers holding this item.

transclusions.description: The origin's transclusions[] verbatim (Transclusion shape, cited included); remote and unvalidated. Null for fragments, L0 items, withdrawn items, or malformed data.

stubOf.description: The origin's stub_of verbatim (CitationTarget shape); remote and unvalidated. Null when none.

forkedFrom.description: The origin's forked_from verbatim (VersionReference shape); remote and unvalidated. Null when none.

generated.description: The origin's generated[] verbatim (GenerationProvenance shape, remote sources' origin and cited included); remote and unvalidated. Null when none.

contentHtml.description: Sanitized, as a subscribed item's is.

subscriptionId.description: The subscription holding this origin, when there is one: open the held copy at /reading/{sub}/{id}.

schema.description: The opaque nextCursor from the preceding page of this collection, filters, and order.

parameters.description: The opaque nextCursor from the preceding page of this collection, filters, and order.
parameters.name: cursor

patch.description: Changing responses or highlight also requires owner:publish because it changes public presentation immediately.

publishedMedia.description: The live version attachments, including retained detached media.

changeCategory.description: The change category the author confirmed in the publish dialog: kept with the version in studio-private storage (never on the wire). Omitted: a classification made for these words stands; null: cleared.

version.description: The version the working copy would publish as.

category.description: Null when no category could be had; see reason.

model.description: The decision model that answered; null for refresh, decided locally from content_hash.

reason.description: Why there is no category: a provider error, an exhausted AI budget, or an unusable answer. Never fatal: publish as usual.

post.description: Attaching new media to a published item also requires owner:publish. Returning an existing duplicate does not.

patch.description: Choosing avatarMediaId also requires owner:publish because the avatar publishes those bytes.

backfill.description: With confirm: start importing the archive at once (true, the default). false creates the subscription only; the next quarter-hour poll imports it, since a never-polled subscription is always due. For bulk imports such as OPML.
